method: Preliminary assistant visual audit, not complete/professional ground truth; no training or local-label threshold fitting

positive_windows.note: 约4.0–4.5秒由站立失衡倒地，随后持续躺卧
约19.5–20.5秒由低姿态前扑倒地，很快被成人遮挡
约31.0–31.5秒椅旁失衡、跌坐，末态不一定是躺卧
约59.5–60.5秒快速失衡倒地，桌沿遮住部分身体

negative_windows.note: Walking practice, seated/bending caregivers; no visible fall on contact-sheet review
Caregiver bending to help; not a new fall
Baby already down after scene cut; not a new fall

excluded_incident_windows.observation: 约43秒椅子倾倒，成人遮住儿童，不能仅凭这些帧确定儿童落地姿态
68.7秒镜头切换后已是躺卧状态，没有看到这次动作的起始阶段
约81秒后降低姿态并被桌沿遮挡，无法在这里确定是跌倒还是主动蹲下

event_rule: score>=.5, TSSTG also top1 Fall Down; >=.25s persistence; 5s per-track cooldown; same track and center inside target region required for positive-window hit
limitations: Four selected positive windows only; event endpoints/target regions approximate
Negatives only 47s, not full-recording false-positive annotation
Ring 4-10s includes a child lowering/occlusion and is excluded from negative windows
All other event times require review; not automatically counted as false positives
onset_note: First two onsets checked at 0.25s contact-sheet resolution; latter two reuse prior approximate visual notes. Events before onset are lead-in alerts, not confirmed fall detections.
